sections.description:
Repeal

ACT XXVI OF 2018
ACT XXVI OF 2018
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE FEDERAL BANK FOR COOPERATIVES
AND REGULATION OF COOPERATIVE BANKING (REPEAL) ACT, 2018
An Act to repeal the Establishment of the Federal
Bank for
Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking
Act, 1977
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
24th May, 2018]
No.
F. 9(9)/2018-Legis, 22.5.2018.---The
following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the
President on 18th May, 2018 and is hereby published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is expedient to repeal the
Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of
Cooperative Banking Act, 1977 (IX of 1977) for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Repeal.---The Establishment of the Federal Bank for
Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking Act, 1977 (IX of 1977) is
hereby repealed.
